text:
Diego: Ran into a weird one
 corporate card charge for ground transport in Berlin soft-declined at checkout but the Uber got completed. Bank later posted the charge as 'pending' then cleared as a slightly different amount. Rider uploaded receipt but the transaction amount doesn't match corporate card extract. What do we do?
Harper: Did the card actually get billed? if cleared, use bank posted amount. If pending/declined and employee paid personal, reimburse if they show proof and manager approves.
Diego: Bank shows a cleared charge for 23.80 EUR but receipt is 21.50 EUR (driver adjusted route). Employee says car-share refunded 2.30 EUR to personal card.
Mina: For audit we need both receipts and the card statement line. Tag the reimbursement as 'adjusted fare, refund processed to personal card' and mark split payment. Also note currency conversion: use bank-cleared EUR->USD rate on posting date per policy.
expense-bot: Flag: discrepancy > 10% requires manager comment.
Diego: Added manager note from Priya: "I approve reimbursing 21.50 EUR; employee refunded 2.30 EUR to personal card, net reimbursable 19.20 EUR".
Harper: OK processing net 19.20 EUR reimbursement. Accounting ref: GL-TR-2024-06-19. Please include evidence files: receipt.jpg, card-statement.pdf, refund-proof.png.
Mina: I'll attach docs and close. Also filing a small policy clarification ticket to clarify soft-decline handling for shared-ride vendors.
Diego: Thanks team :thumbsup:
